title: Zenith Motors to acquire Orion Steel for $2.1 billion
text: Zenith Motors Ltd has agreed to acquire Orion Steel Corp in a deal valued at $2.1 billion, the companies said on 14 March 2026. Orion Steel Corp, a subsidiary of Titan Chemicals Corp, makes specialty alloys for the automotive industry. Zenith Motors said the acquisition will secure its supply chain. Titan Chemicals Corp's subsidiary Orion Steel employs about 9,000 people.

title: Apex Pharma and Helios Energy to merge
text: Apex Pharma Inc and Helios Energy PLC have agreed to merge in an all-stock transaction worth $7.8 billion. The merger of Apex Pharma and Helios Energy was approved by both boards on 2 April 2026. Helios Energy PLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Meridian Insurance Co, will become part of the combined entity.

title: Quantum Retail to sell its Lotus Foods unit for Rs 3,500 crore
text: Quantum Retail Group will sell its Lotus Foods unit to Evergreen Agro Ltd for Rs 3,500 crore, as it exits non-core businesses. Quantum Retail Group said the sale will close in June 2026. Lotus Foods Ltd, a subsidiary of Quantum Retail Group, runs 120 stores.

title: Bluewave Telecom launches hostile takeover bid for Crescent Textiles
text: Bluewave Telecom Ltd launches hostile takeover bid for Crescent Textiles Ltd with an unsolicited $450 million offer. The board of Crescent Textiles has adopted a poison pill to fend off the bid. Shareholders will decide on 20 May 2026.

title: Falcon Airlines appoints Priya Nair as new CEO
text: Falcon Airlines appoints Priya Nair as new Chief Executive Officer with immediate effect. Rahul Mehta resigns as CEO of Falcon Airlines after seven years. The change was announced on 5 June 2026.

title: Nimbus Cloud files draft papers for IPO to raise $1.2 billion
text: Nimbus Cloud Inc files draft papers with the regulator for an IPO to raise $1.2 billion. The cloud company plans to list its shares later this year.

title: Sensex and Nifty close higher as banking stocks rally
text: Indian benchmark indices ended higher on Tuesday as banking stocks rallied. Investors are watching inflation data due later this week and expect the central bank to keep interest rates unchanged.

title: Vertex Bank reports quarterly profit rise of 12 percent
text: Vertex Bank reported a 12 percent rise in quarterly profit, helped by strong loan growth. The bank declared an interim dividend for shareholders.

title: Atlas Logistics completes acquisition of Harbor Shipping
text: Atlas Logistics Ltd completes acquisition of Harbor Shipping Co for $95 million, the company said on 11 July 2026. Atlas Logistics holds a 60% stake in Pioneer Software Inc. Harbor Shipping Co, owned by Redwood Media Group, was a long-time rival.

title: Sunrise Hospitals names Meera Iyer Chairperson
text: Sunrise Hospitals Ltd names Meera Iyer Chairperson after the retirement of the previous chair. Arjun Kapoor steps down as Managing Director of Sunrise Hospitals Ltd.

title: Oil prices slip as demand outlook weakens
text: Oil prices slipped on Wednesday as the demand outlook weakened and the dollar strengthened. Analysts expect volatility ahead of the next OPEC meeting.

title: Summit Cement posts record volumes this year
text: Evergreen Agro Ltd's subsidiary Summit Cement Ltd posted record volumes this year. Summit Cement Ltd was acquired by Evergreen Agro Ltd in 2024 for Rs 12,000 crore.
